name: Winar Connection
old_description: Winar has been in the wire and cable industry since 1982. Since then we have focused on developing and perfecting our processes for large cable, wire harness & leads, and so much more!
about:
Winar Connection was founded in 1982 in Richfield, Ohio, as a family-run business focused on wire and cable solutions. The company later expanded to a second facility in Spartanburg, South Carolina, while maintaining its headquarters in Richfield. Ownership remains American-made and American-owned, with the founding family still guiding operations after more than four decades.

The company manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and wire leads, offering precision cutting, stripping, crimping, custom labeling, and value-added assembly services. Its production floor includes a Schleuniger Crimp Center 64 purchased in 2013, multiple fully automatic crimping machines, a braiding machine, and an ultrasonic welder. Winar also operates vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and stocking programs for customers. The workforce averages 20 years of tenure, representing over 100 years of combined applied knowledge.

Winar serves industries including motive power, battery charging, electrical power grid, load banks, and data centers. Its customers range from purchasing agents and engineers seeking custom cable solutions to vendor partners who access Winar’s broad customer base across those sectors.

The company emphasizes its American-made, American-owned identity, supported by certifications such as UL, IPC, ISO 9001:2015, and WHMA. Its stated values—integrity, caring, inspiration, excellence, and continuous improvement—underpin a “WIN” philosophy built on wisdom, improvement, and nimbleness.
